title: kr-alpha-signal-v2 weekly prospective receipt
description: One immutable, append-only record per weekly KR decision session, written after the signal session's close and before the next session opens. Built and validated by pipeline/kr_alpha_signal_v2_receipts.py on the storage format of pipeline/prospective_receipt_core.py (the same canonical JSON and digest rule as the existing study receipts). A receipt carries what was known and decided, never an outcome; outcomes are separate PROSPECTIVE_OUTCOME records keyed by receiptSha256 and built only after the horizon matures. Two pathways (LIVE, SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE) never meet. No receipt is prospective evidence until a frozen design is merged and an authorization is registered; none is registered.

pathway.description: LIVE receipts are built only from the registered authorization, hash their identities from disk and read the writer's own clock; SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE receipts exist for tests and can never pass live validation or enter a live ledger

designDigest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every frozen design constant (kr_alpha_signal_v2.design_constants)

authorization.description: the merge that froze the design; firstProspectiveSession is the first KR session strictly after the KST date of the merge

signalDate.description: a KR session whose next KR session lies in a later ISO week

executionDate.description: the next KR session; the receipt was created before it opened

createdAtUtc.description: timezone-aware; at or after 18:00 KST (09:00 UTC) of the signal session, the latest moment any KRX day variant is final, and before 09:00 KST of the execution session

trainingCutoff.description: the forecast's training cutoff, strictly before the signal date; null when no forecast exists

coverage.description: eligible, value-measured and confirmation-measured counts with their denominators

signal.description: per-name signal records; null when BLOCKED

forecast.description: authorized calibrated forecast (per-name expectedExcessReturn, standardError, additive contributions); null when BLOCKED or NOT_READY

evidenceClass.description: PROSPECTIVE_PAPER exactly when pathway is LIVE

receiptSha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every other field
